zh.title: Iberia將派A321XLR執飛日全食觀測包機
zh.summary: 西班牙Iberia航空將於2026年8月12日，使用全新空中巴士A321XLR客機執飛代號IB1473的特別觀測包機。該航班將搭載Shelios計畫的科研團隊，從馬德里起飛並於1萬公尺高空觀測日全食。航空公司亦計畫利用機上的SpaceX Starlink衛星網路在社群媒體進行空中直播。
body: 西班牙Iberia航空宣布將於2026年8月12日執飛一班特別包機，以觀測當天在西班牙部分地區出現的日全食。該航班代號為IB1473，計畫於當地時間18時45分自馬德里-巴拉哈斯國際機場（MAD）起飛，並使用其全新的空中巴士A321XLR客機，飛越西班牙中北部的帕倫西亞省。
此航班將搭載Shelios計畫的科研團隊，於1萬公尺高空提供無雲阻礙的視野，用以測量太陽形態及觀測其他天體。此外，Iberia航空計畫利用該A321XLR客機配備的SpaceX Starlink衛星網路，在社群媒體上實況直播此次日全食畫面。

en.title: Iberia to Operate Special A321XLR Flight for Solar Eclipse Observation
en.summary: Spanish flag carrier Iberia has announced plans to operate a special charter flight on August 12, 2026, to observe a total solar eclipse. The airline will deploy its new Airbus A321XLR aircraft for flight IB1473, which is scheduled to depart Madrid-Barajas International Airport (MAD) at 18:45 local time. The flight will carry scientific researchers from the Shelios program and fly over Spain's Palencia province at an altitude of 10,000 meters to provide an unobstructed view. Iberia plans to broadcast the astronomical event live via social media, utilizing the aircraft's onboard SpaceX Starlink satellite-based internet connectivity.
body: Spanish carrier Iberia will operate a special charter flight, designated IB1473, on August 12, 2026, to observe a total solar eclipse over Spain. The flight is scheduled to depart Madrid-Barajas International Airport at 18:45 local time, utilizing a new Airbus A321XLR aircraft to fly a specialized route over Palencia province.

The flight will carry researchers from the Shelios program at an altitude of 10,000 meters to ensure an unobstructed view above the clouds. Iberia plans to broadcast the eclipse live on social media using the aircraft's onboard Starlink satellite internet connectivity, provided by SpaceX.

zh.title: Joby規劃9月展開美國eVTOL整合試飛計畫
zh.summary: Joby Aviation於2026年8月5日表示，預計將於2026年9月在德克薩斯州展開美國eVTOL整合試飛計畫（eIPP）的首次飛行，並維持在2026年底前載運首批乘客的目標。該試飛計畫允許參與者在與美國聯邦航空總署協議下，操作尚未取得型別認證的航空器以收集營運數據。
body: Joby Aviation於2026年8月5日公佈第二季財報時表示，預計將於2026年9月在德克薩斯州展開美國eVTOL整合試飛計畫（eIPP）的首次飛行任務。這家總部位於加利福尼亞州的製造商同時維持其在2026年底前載運首批乘客的既定目標。
美國eVTOL整合試飛計畫由白宮行政命令設立，聯邦航空總署（FAA）與美國運輸部於2026年3月9日選出首批八個項目。該計畫允許參與者在與FAA直接協商的協議下，操作尚未獲得型別認證的航空器，以收集營運數據供未來制定法規參考。
在德克薩斯州推動的項目由德克薩斯州運輸部主管，參與企業除了Joby Aviation外，還包括Archer Aviation、Beta Technologies與Wisk。該項目計畫連結達拉斯、奧斯汀與聖安東尼奧，並預計最終延伸至休士頓。
財務方面，Joby Aviation報告第二季來自其於2025年收購的直升機營運商Blade之營收為3,620萬美元，並將2026全年的營收展望上調至1.15億美元至1.25億美元之間。公司截至2026年6月30日持有23億美元的現金與短期投資。
此外，該公司於2026年8月4日宣佈與Travis Kalanick創辦的工業人工智慧與基礎設施企業Atoms建立合作夥伴關係，旨在於美國首發市場開發多模態交通樞紐。

en.title: Joby Aviation Targets September for First US eVTOL Integration Pilot Program Flights
en.summary: Joby Aviation announced on August 5, 2026, that it expects to begin its first flights under the US eVTOL Integration Pilot Program (eIPP) in September 2026, with initial operations scheduled in Texas. The manufacturer maintained its goal of carrying its first passengers before the end of 2026. Under the White House-backed program, participants can operate uncertified aircraft under FAA agreements to collect operational data for future rulemaking. The Texas project, led by the Texas Department of Transportation alongside Archer Aviation, Beta Technologies, and Wisk, aims to connect Dallas, Austin, San Antonio, and eventually Houston.
body: Joby Aviation expects to conduct its initial flights under the US eVTOL Integration Pilot Program (eIPP) in September 2026, with first operations taking place in Texas. The California-based manufacturer released the timeline on August 5, 2026, alongside its second-quarter financial results, while maintaining its target to carry its first passengers before the end of 2026.

The eIPP initiative was established by presidential executive order, with its first eight projects selected on March 9, 2026, by the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) and the US Department of Transportation. The program framework allows participating companies to operate aircraft that have not yet received type certification, under agreements negotiated directly with the FAA, to gather operational data for future regulatory frameworks.

The Texas project under eIPP is led by the Texas Department of Transportation and includes participation from Archer Aviation, Beta Technologies, and Wisk. The regional initiative is designed to link Dallas, Austin, and San Antonio, with plans to expand operational routes to Houston in later phases.

Alongside its operational guidance, Joby reported second-quarter revenue of $36.2 million from Blade, the helicopter operator acquired in 2025. The company raised its full-year 2026 revenue outlook to between $115 million and $125 million, while holding $2.3 billion in cash and short-term investments as of June 30, 2026.

Joby also announced on August 4, 2026, a strategic partnership with Atoms, an industrial artificial intelligence and infrastructure firm founded by Travis Kalanick. The collaboration focuses on developing multimodal transport hubs across Joby's planned launch markets in the United States.

zh.title: Delta開航亞特蘭大至利雅德 預訂偏軟推優惠
zh.summary: Delta已確認將於10月正式開航亞特蘭大至利雅德服務，這也是該航空公司首條飛往沙烏地阿拉伯的航線。根據Simple Flying報導，由於初期機票預訂情況較預期疲軟，Delta目前已針對該航線推出折扣優惠，同時維持10月開航時程。
body: 根據 Simple Flying 報導，Delta 已確認將於 10 月正式開航亞特蘭大至利雅德（Atlanta-Riyadh）服務。該航空公司正準備啟動這條航線，這也標誌著其首條飛往沙烏地阿拉伯的航線。
報導指出，在遭遇「低於預期」（softer than anticipated）的初始機票預訂情況後，Delta 已針對這條沙烏地阿拉伯航線推出折扣優惠。儘管訂位需求較預期疲軟，該公司仍維持於 10 月正式推出亞特蘭大至利雅德航班的既定計畫。

en.title: Delta Discounts Atlanta-Riyadh Route Amid Softer Booking Demand
en.summary: Delta has officially confirmed an October launch date for its upcoming flights connecting Atlanta and Riyadh, which represents the airline's first-ever service to Saudi Arabia. According to reporting by Simple Flying, the carrier has introduced discounted fares on the new route after observing flight reservation levels that were characterized as softer than anticipated. Despite the initial booking demand, Delta is proceeding with its planned schedule to begin operations on the Atlanta-Riyadh route in October.
body: Delta has confirmed an October launch date for its new service connecting Atlanta and Riyadh. The airline is preparing to inaugurate flights on the route, which represents its first-ever route to Saudi Arabia, with passenger operations scheduled to commence during October.

According to reporting by Simple Flying, Delta has introduced discounted pricing on the route after experiencing initial flight bookings that were described as softer than anticipated. The carrier is offering lower ticket prices for the Atlanta and Riyadh service while continuing to maintain its target of launching flights in October.

zh.title: 漢光演習台北港防禦 動員貨輪漁船封阻航道
zh.summary: 國軍漢光42號實兵演習於8月6日第2天在台北港進行要港防禦演練，動員1艘800噸貨輪與16艘漁船執行航道封阻，並部署貨櫃與水泥塊架設道路阻絕設施，以強化關鍵設施防禦並爭取縱深防禦時間。
body: 台灣國軍「漢光42號」實兵演習於2026年8月5日至14日實施，展開為期10天9夜的演訓。在8月6日演習第二天，軍方於台北港進行要港防禦演練，旨在強化關鍵基礎設施防禦並爭取縱深防禦時間。
在台北港演練中，軍方動員1艘800噸貨輪及16艘漁船進行航道封阻。演練亦投入1座浮箱站台與28個貨櫃進行港務整合，並部署80個太空包及150塊2噸水泥塊架設聯外道路阻絕設施。
此外，宜蘭縣後備指揮部後備軍人輔導中心亦配合蘭陽地區指揮部，於轄區灘岸聯外道路執行阻絕架設。國防部表示，相關課目旨在執行反資敵與航道阻絕，以延滯敵軍推進並爭取應處時間。

en.title: Taiwan Han Kuang Exercise Tests Taipei Port Defense with Vessel Blockade
en.summary: During the second day of Taiwan's Han Kuang 42 live-troop exercise on August 6, 2026, the military conducted key port defense drills at Taipei Port to strengthen critical infrastructure defenses and gain time for depth defense. Reservists were mobilized with one 800-ton cargo vessel and 16 fishing boats to perform shipping channel blockades. The exercise also deployed 150 concrete blocks, 80 jumbo bags, and 28 containers for port integration and road obstacle setups, while Yilan reserve auxiliary units supported beach defense operations.
body: Taiwan's Armed Forces conducted key port defense exercises at Taipei Port on August 6, 2026, marking the second day of the 10-day, 9-night Han Kuang 42 live-troop exercise running from August 5 to 14. The drill aimed to strengthen critical infrastructure defense and gain time for depth defense operations.

As part of the channel blockage exercise at Taipei Port, the military mobilized one 800-ton cargo ship and 16 fishing vessels through reserve recruitment. The drill also utilized one floating pontoon platform, 28 containers, 80 jumbo bags, and 150 two-ton concrete blocks for port logistics integration and outer road obstacle deployment.

Additionally, reserve auxiliary centers in Yilan County cooperated with the Lanyang Regional Command to execute beach obstacle operations on coastal roads. The Ministry of National Defense stated that these measures, including anti-denial and channel obstruction maneuvers, are designed to delay enemy advances and buy time for troop maneuvering.
